title: Intervals of Stillness
deck: Three quiet interiors where shadow, curve, and interval teach the eye to linger a little longer.

features.headline: A Room That Breathes In Curves
features.narrative: Seating sits low while lighting draws a thin edge across the interior. The eye follows the bend, then pauses where shadow gathers. The appearance here appears fabric-like in one interval and appears stone-like in another, but it is the spacing between forms that holds attention.
features.discoveryQuestion: Where does the curve open into space, and where does shadow close it again?

features.headline: What We Carry Through Light
features.narrative: An accessory rests near folded clothing against a pale architectural edge. Light falls from one side, narrowing then widening the frame. What appears fabric-like softens the geometry, while shadow gives the composition its quiet punctuation.
features.discoveryQuestion: How does a small accessory change the scale of the architecture around it?

features.headline: Shelter Found In The Interval
features.narrative: Lighting, seating, and architecture align like markers along an interior passage. The view moves from foreground weight to open distance. Surfaces that appear wood-like in one area and appear paper-like in another catch light differently, letting the path-and-shelter rhythm lead the eye forward.
features.discoveryQuestion: Follow the sheltered path in the image — what waits past the brightest point?
